scope: Local append-only research registration, clock/integrity gates, public data feasibility and synthetic acceptance only; no new strategy or performance computation

registry.storage: separate immutable protocol, evidence, candidate and label JSON records, one global SHA256 chain; exclusive writer; verify pinned external checkpoint against every later chain
registry.clock: writer records actual UTC receipt/registration time; injected clocks only in explicitly synthetic registries; source publication unknown remains null
registry.eligibility: formation after frozen study start; closed 1H/4H/1D evidence; receipt before candidate; registration strictly before future observation; unconfirmed remains watch
registry.versions: deterministic event identity, append-only candidate revisions, label references exact candidate hash; never mutate prior candidate or protocol
registry.labels: separate results store; no result fields accepted in candidate; only after full predefined window; incomplete evidence means unknown results
registry.security_limit: hash chains and read-only files are tamper-evident against pinned checkpoints, not physical WORM storage or proof of trustworthy source/system clocks

forward_operational_floor_from_p1_08a.review: fixed calendar dates frozen by next real hypothesis, no performance-based early stopping, no real hypothesis activated in P1-08C

data_feasibility: primary official public Spot documentation plus bounded no-key read-only connectivity probes; never turn failures or documentation examples into observed liquidity
acceptance: causal time and schema negative cases
all Python tests with fixed dependencies
download and verify final Actions artifact
